name: Campingplatz Seewang
beschreibung: Campingplatz Seewang is located in Bezirk Kufstein in Tirol. The immediate surroundings are characterized by forest and meadows. A small lake is within walking distance. The site has parceled pitches with electricity connections. A sanitary building with showers and toilets is available. There is a common room and a children's playground. The atmosphere is relaxed and close to nature. The campsite appeals to hiking guests and those seeking peace and quiet.
